notes: Taxonomy describes what an Evidence Unit is about; it does not decide whether the unit is included.
PERIPHERAL_FUNCTIONAL describes functional peripheral material that is outside the programming-evidence seed set unless dependency closure requires it.

DOCUMENT_STRUCTURE covers table-of-contents/list/navigation pages; PACKAGE_MECHANICAL covers package-outline/mechanical material; ELECTRICAL_OTHER covers electrical material not admitted as programming-relevant general electrical evidence.
UNKNOWN is a valid classification state and fails closed through the v0 rule set.
